_comment: Model properties and boundaries. context_window = total context window in tokens as stated on the vendor model page (input plus output), max_output in tokens, temp_max for temperature models, thinking_max for extended thinking models. release_date = provider announcement date (release_date_assumed = family-head date, verify in next FULL run). uc_class = Universal Class (UC-1 Apex, UC-2 Flagship, UC-3 Balanced, UC-4 Efficient), hand-set from vendor tier wording. eci_score and eci_ci [low, high] = Epoch Capabilities Index score and 95% interval (written from match-epoch-eci.py output; null without an Epoch row). depth = append-only ladder rung (1 = shallowest) written once by layer-depth-ladder.py, depth_evidence = the edge that set it, depth_estimated = E6 estimate (the only rung that may change, to measured). deeper_than = manual E1/E4 edges {model, kind, source, accessed, statement}. items = measured instruction items per prompt (from observed, sequences >= 3). scope_guard = strict when a FAILS or ledger entry documents unrequested actions. inventory_note = hand-maintained Notes text for MODEL_INVENTORY.md.
